blocks.plainText: In all districts, as indicated, the location of primary business entrances, show windows, or signs shall be subject to the provisions of this Section. For the purposes of this Section, a lot of record or a group of contiguous lots of record held in single ownership or control at December 15, 1961, or any applicable amendment thereto, shall be considered a single zoning lot, regardless of any subsequent subdivision.

blocks.html: For the purposes of this Section, a corner lot shall include the entire zoning lot, notwithstanding the 100 foot limitation in the definition of corner lots in Section 12-10 (DEFINITIONS). All other zoning lots shall be considered zoning lots with single frontage.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Title change (was "Surface Area and Illumination Provisions"). Surface area and illumination provisions were moved to Section 42-63, while limitations on business entrances, show windows or signs were relocated from Section 42-44 to here, title and text unchanged
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
